name: Netherite Mod
author: minecraftbossdj
description: A Mod for hellish ends that adds netherite! There is also a new addition: Scrap ore, spawns in the overworld! You get 2 nuggets per ore, and 9 nuggets make one scrap. Smithing template is also here!
extended_description:
A Mod for hellish ends that adds netherite!

Currently the ore gen is broken (from what ive tested) and only spawns ore in the overworld, so i decided to add: Scrap Ore in the overworld!  you get 2 nuggets per ore, and 9 nuggets make one scrap. The smithing template is still required so you still need to go to the nether.
